strings.widget_config_4x3_body: Họrọ bọtịnụ ozi abụọ. A na-egosi Taa na elekere mgbe niile n'elu.
strings.widget_config_calendar_4x4_v2_body: Họrọ bọtịnụ mkpirikpi abụọ. A na-egosi kalenda na nhazi oge echi mgbe niile.
strings.widget_config_calendar_4x4_v3_body: Naanị nghọta ndabere ka enwere ike ịhazi.
strings.alarm_repeat_after_ignored_body: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanyụghị ma ọ bụ yigharịghị ya, mkpu ga-akpọ ọzọ.
strings.settings_speech_models_search_hint: Chọọ asụsụ ma ọ bụ ụdị
strings.settings_speech_models_download_continue: Nbudata ụdị na-aga n'ihu ọbụna ma ị pụọ na ihuenyo a.
strings.settings_permissions_alarm_geo_summary_b: Hazie ntụkwasị obi mkpu ịkpọte, ohere ọnọdụ mkpu ebe na ntọala batrị n'otu ebe.
strings.settings_permissions_geo_first_launch_bo: Mkpu ebe chọrọ ohere ọnọdụ, ọnọdụ ziri ezi na ọnọdụ n'azụ ka ọ nwee ike ịgbalite mgbe emechiri ngwa. Ị nwere ike ịgbanye ha na ntọala ngwa.
strings.settings_permissions_unrestricted_body: Maka mkpu na mkpu ebe a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi, wepụ mmachi batrị maka ShiftAlarm. Na Xiaomi/Redmi na ngwaọrụ yiri ya, kwekwa ka mmalite onwe ya/ọrụ n'azụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị.
strings.settings_backup_save_body: Mepụta faịlụ ndabere ma họrọ ebe ị ga-echekwa ya na ngwaọrụ a.
strings.settings_backup_share_body: Mepụta faịlụ ndabere ma mepee mpempe nkekọrịta sistemụ iji zipụ ya na ozi-e, onye ozi ma ọ bụ nchekwa igwe ojii.
strings.settings_backup_export_share_success_bod: Họrọ ebe ị ga-eziga ma ọ bụ bulite faịlụ ndabere.
strings.settings_backup_export_share_error_body: Enweghị ike imepụta ma ọ bụ ịkekọrịta faịlụ ndabere.
strings.shifts_salary_deduction_constant_carry_h: A na-ebufe mwepu na-adịgide gaa ọnwa na-esote na-akpaghị aka.
strings.settings_legal_button_body: Mepee usoro ojiji, amụma nzuzo, nkwupụta na ntuziaka onye ọrụ.
strings.legal_documents_intro_body: Akwụkwọ dị offline. Mgbe ịntanetị dị, ShiftAlarm nwere ike ibudata ụdị ọhụrụ ma jiri ndị etinyere n'ime ngwa dịka ndabere.
strings.legal_privacy_body: Otu esi ejikwa data ngwa dị n'ime ngwaọrụ, nnyocha na nbudata.
strings.legal_disclaimer_body: Mmachi ntụkwasị obi dị mkpa maka mkpu, ọkwa na geofence.
strings.legal_help_body: Ntuziaka offline maka ọrụ isi nke ngwa.
strings.legal_document_unavailable_body: Enweghị ike imeghe akwụkwọ ahụ. Lelee njikọ ma ọ bụ nwaa ọzọ emechaa.
strings.onboarding_step_welcome_body: ShiftAlarm na-ejikọta nhazi oge ọrụ, mkpu, mkpu ebe, ndetu, wijetị na ngwaọrụ ndabere. Ihuenyo isi adịlarị n'azụ windo nhazi a.
strings.onboarding_step_documents_body: Biko mepee akwụkwọ ngwa ma nabata ụdị ndị achọrọ. Ha na-akọwa usoro ojiji, nzuzo na mmachi ntụkwasị obi maka mkpu, ọkwa na mkpu ebe.
strings.onboarding_step_permissions_body: A chọghị ikike iji legharịa ngwa anya, mana mkpu, ihe ncheta na mkpu ebe dabere na ọkwa, mkpu oge kpọmkwem, ọnọdụ na ntọala batrị.
strings.onboarding_permissions_ready: Ntọala niile dị mkpa adịla njikere.
strings.onboarding_cannot_continue_documents: Nabata akwụkwọ ka ị gaa n'ihu
strings.onboarding_permissions_finish_hint: Ị nwere ike imecha ugbu a ma laghachi na ikike emechaa site na Ntọala.
strings.settings_help_training_button_body: Mepee ntuziaka onye ọrụ offline na windo nchọgharị dị iche.
strings.help_training_offer_body: Mepee ntuziaka onye ọrụ ka ịmụta ihe ọrụ isi ọ bụla na-eme, ebe ọ dị, ihe ị ga-pịa na ihe ị ga-elele ma ọ bụrụ na ihe anaghị arụ ọrụ dịka atụụrụ anya.
strings.help_training_offer_hint: Ntuziaka na-emeghe dịka ibe mpaghara dị iche, yabụ ị nwere ike ịgbanwe n'etiti ntuziaka na ngwa mgbe ị na-eso nzọụkwụ.
strings.help_training_offer_open_failed: Enweghị ike imeghe ntuziaka. Nwaa ọzọ site na Ntọala.
strings.settings_theme_language_group_body: A chịkọtara ọdịdị, asụsụ ngwa na ụdị okwu na-enweghị ịntanetị n'ebe a.
strings.settings_documents_instruction_group_bod: A chịkọtara akwụkwọ, enyemaka, ọzụzụ na ntuziaka onye ọrụ n'ebe a.
